name: Declares Ref
description: A repository declares a named reference — a branch or a tag — in its refs namespace. Property-free: ref movement is field history on the ref's head_sha, not a property here. Moved from github_core's HAS_REF (github-core#76): the source is now the neutral repository, and the verb is the mechanical one (the structure validator rejects HAS_ as a state, not an action).
